items.title: Lyft Launches $9.99-a-Month Program With DoorDash Membership
items.summary: Lyft Inc. is launching a new loyalty program that includes a DoorDash Inc. membership and credits toward future rides or delivery orders, setting it up to better compete with rival Uber Technologies Inc.'s subscription offering.

items.title: DoorDash Sinks 13% as Amazon Taps Uber Eats for $0 Prime Restaurant Delivery
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDoorDash shares fell 13% today after Amazon and Uber said Prime members now pay a $0 delivery fee on Uber Eats restaurant orders of $25 or more. Prime members have had free Grubhub+ since 2022, and DoorDash still took 59% of delivery-app spending last quarter, so I think the selloff overshoots the threat.

items.title: Amazon and Uber Want to Bring You Your Next Meal. The Delivery Turf War Is Escalating.
items.summary: Amazon and Uber are teaming up to deliver restaurant meals directly through the Amazon app and website.

items.title: Amazon, Uber Partner on Restaurant Delivery as Competition Intensifies
items.summary: The partnership further entwines Amazon and Uber’s businesses, and comes as both companies face the threat of a much bigger delivery competitor after DoorDash said last week it plans to acquire Instacart for $17 billion.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of DoorDash (DASH) on Nov. 3
items.summary: DoorDash saw $18.5 million in net ETF selling on Tuesday, as 27 funds bought and 14 sold.

items.title: Uber Rises 5% on Q3 Beat as Robotaxi Push Turns to “Commercial Execution”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUber stock jumped 5% today after third-quarter non-GAAP EPS of $0. 88 edged past estimates and Gross Bookings grew 20%.

items.title: DoorDash is buying Instacart for $17 billion. Its employees can’t add Instacart staff on LinkedIn
items.summary: An internal Q&A filed with the SEC tells DoorDash staff to stay unconnected until the deal closes, which could be mid-2028, to avoid antitrust trouble.

items.title: Uber Climbs 7% Despite Soft Profit Outlook as Delivery Strength Shines; Lyft Jumps 11%, DoorDash Gains 7%
items.summary: Uber's delivery business just ignited a rally across the entire ride-hailing and food delivery sector, but the profit warning hiding inside the results tells a more complicated story about where this group is actually headed.
